_note: Chitonga wordings found in the manuscripts themselves (not on the author's form). Added as extra variants. The ECE Learner's Book spells its unit word CIBEELA (the Form 4 author's form gave CIPATI), and titles its front matter MAJWI AANTALISYO / MATALIKILO A BBUKU. The activity word is Cakuchita: Chitonga writes the verb stem -chita with ch, and the user corrected the manuscript (which uses Cakucita) on that point.
